Daytona USA -- Steam Deck (native Vulkan) -- BETA 1.2
=====================================================

Beta 1.2 fixes the attract-mode freeze (picture stuck, music playing out,
no input) that beta 1.1 hit after the first attract loop. Everything past
the title screen is still lightly tested on this hardware -- that is what
this beta is for.

TO PLAY

  Desktop Mode: run ./run.sh from this folder (Konsole, or double-click and
  choose Execute). Game Mode: add ./run.sh as a non-Steam game.

  The first launch is the slow one -- up to a minute of black window before
  the SEGA logo while the files come off disk. Later launches are faster.

KNOWN / EXPECTED

  * Needs SteamOS with glibc 2.38+ (any 2025+ SteamOS is fine). If it will
    not start, run.sh writes deck-report.txt -- send that.
  * Boot is slower than the Windows build on the same content. Known, being
    worked on.
  * Sound, controller input, and everything past the title screen have had
    almost no Deck testing. Reports valuable.

Please send back the newest file in logs/ with any report.
Please do not redistribute this build.
